body.statement: Using the handle \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{exact}}\), determine whether \(\kappa_-=\kappa_+\), compute the common constant if it exists, and characterize all asymptotically extremal dual-tight obstruction geometries up to dummy-row padding, replication, and vanishing perturbations. If the limit fails to exist, determine the exact set of subsequential limits of \(N\Delta_N\).
body.justification: The order theorem leaves a nontrivial geometric extremal problem rather than presenting the loose universal constant as sharp.
body.gap: Neither empirical Monge counterexamples nor mixability approximation theory identifies the exact normalized same-marginal squared-cost loss or its extremizers.
body.consumer: An exact constant would replace the conservative universal width by a sharp planning and reporting benchmark at moderate trial sizes.

obligation.what_is_open: Whether \(\kappa_-=\kappa_+\), the value of a common limit if it exists, and the classification of all asymptotically extremal dual-tight geometries remain open.
obligation.obstruction: The handle \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{exact}}\) specifies a research program but supplies neither a proved finite obstruction catalogue nor a compactness theorem preserving normalized slack under block decomposition.  The multiscale upper proof loses constants at the cluster-count, residual, and quadratic-charge inequalities, while the padded four-row witness need not maximize any of them.
obligation.attempted: The ordered slope intervals were compressed into nested dyadic blocks, residual tables were sparsified and repaired exactly, and the four-row zero-slack face was solved over the reals and integers.  These steps close the uniform rate but provide no matching constant-level variational principle or exclusion of larger irreducible blocks.
obligation.partial_result:
The proved frontier gives the nontrivial compact localization
\[
 \frac1{46080}\le \kappa_-\le\kappa_+\le3456.
\]
The lower endpoint is witnessed for every \(N\ge4\) by one fixed four-row obstruction padded with isolated dummy rows, while the upper endpoint follows from the ordered-support multiscale repair.  Thus the order and the absence of an arithmetic exceptional subsequence are settled, but equality of the two asymptotic constants and the classification of all extremal obstruction geometries are not.
